lines: #Motivation will *leave* you.
It always does. Usually around day *three.*
It shows up when things are easy, and disappears when things get *hard.*
#That's why the people who win don't *rely* on it.
They rely on *discipline.*
Discipline is doing it when you don't *feel* like it.
When it's cold. When you're tired. When nobody would *know.*
#Feelings are *visitors.*
Let them come. Let them go. But don't let them *drive.*
You don't wait to feel confident before you *start.*
You start, and confidence *follows.*
#Every time you keep a promise to yourself, something *changes.*
Discipline is quiet. It doesn't need an *audience.*
It just needs you to *keep* going.
Same time. Same effort. *Every* day.
You start to *trust* yourself again.
And a person who trusts themselves is very hard to *stop.*
So stop waiting for the *spark.*
Build the *fire* yourself.
#Show up today. Especially if you *don't* want to.
That's the rep that *counts.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

lines: MOTIVATION
IS A
LIE.

post.title: Motivation Will Leave You. Do This Instead.
post.caption: Feelings are visitors. Don't let them drive. 🔥 Save this for the days you don't feel like it.
post.first_comment: What's one thing you'll do today even if you don't feel like it? 👇
